question: What kind of initiation must those who endure the pairs of opposites observe?
premises: Some candidates are able to endure the pairs of opposites.
For them a seeded initiation consisting of pledges confers grace.
They must also observe the special pledges.
inference: Candidates who endure opposites receive a seeded, pledge-based initiation and are bound to keep its special pledges.
uncertainties: vidvaddvandva may refer to learned endurance of opposites or more generally to those who can bear dualities.
plain_english: But for those who can endure the pairs of opposites, there is a seeded initiation made of pledges that confers grace. They must observe it, and they must also keep the special pledges.
